 WITH 554 APPEARANCES 
 Oblak becomes the player with the second-most appearances in our history
 November 8, 2026 - 21:01 
 The Slovenian goalkeeper moves ahead of Adelardo Rodríguez to become the player with the second-most appearances in Atlético de Madrid's history.
 Following Sunday's match against Barcelona, Jan Oblak has now made 554 appearances for Atlético de Madrid. He moves ahead of the great Adelardo Rodríguez to become the player with the second-most official appearances in the club's history. Koke Resurrección continues to lead the way, having now made 751 appearances.
 The Slovenian goalkeeper, who made his club debut on 16 September 2014 against Olympiacos, has kept 239 clean sheets (43% of his appearances) and is also the goalkeeper to have won the Zamora Trophy the most times in LaLiga history (6).
 These individual achievements add even more prestige to a trophy cabinet that includes a league title (2020/21), UEFA Super Cup (2018/19), UEFA Europa League (2017/18) and Spanish Super Cup (2014/15), all won during his time at the club.
 Congratulations, Jan!
